title: X-Grafana-User header must be sent for service accounts too
answers: Why is X-Grafana-User missing for service account requests?
Proxy requests from service accounts lack identity header
How to make ApplyUserHeader include service accounts
X-Grafana-User header not set for non-user identity types
body:
Symptom: Downstream proxied requests (e.g. datasource proxy) made on behalf of a service account were missing the X-Grafana-User header, even though the same requests worked for regular users.
Root cause: pkg/util/proxyutil/proxyutil.go:ApplyUserHeader only set the header when `user.IsIdentityType(claims.TypeUser)`, excluding claims.TypeServiceAccount.
Fix pattern: extend the IsIdentityType check to include all identity types that should receive the header (claims.TypeUser, claims.TypeServiceAccount) rather than gating on a single type.
Constraints: applies specifically to ApplyUserHeader's identity-type gate; if a new identity type is added and should also carry X-Grafana-User (e.g. via login/service-account impersonation), it must be added to this same IsIdentityType call, not handled elsewhere.
applies: pkg/util/proxyutil/proxyutil.go ApplyUserHeader and any caller relying on X-Grafana-User being set for service accounts
